title: Multi-Step and Compound Inequalities
seo_title: Algebra 1 Inequalities Worksheets: Multi-Step and Compound Inequalities with Graphs (Free, Answer Key)
standard_text: Solve linear equations and inequalities in one variable, including equations with coefficients represented by letters.
meta_desc: Free Algebra 1 inequalities worksheets (A-REI.B.3): multi-step inequalities, variables on both sides, compound inequalities with and and or, graphing on a number line, and word problems. 100 questions with an answer key.
key_big: Divide or multiply by a negative? Reverse the sign.
key_sub: And: the part in between. Or: two separate directions. Do the same to every part.
body_html:
How it works

Solve a multi-step inequality like an equation. The one change: if you multiply or divide by a negative number, reverse the inequality sign.

A compound inequality joins two inequalities. With and, both must be true, so the graph is the part in between: −2 < x ≤ 3. With or, either can be true, so the graph goes out in two directions: x < −2 or x ≥ 3. For a three-part inequality, do the same thing to all three parts.

Example

Solve 2x + 5 > 4x − 7.

Subtract 4x: −2x + 5 > −7.

Subtract 5: −2x > −12.

Divide by −2 and reverse.

Answer: x < 6

Example

Solve −3 ≤ 2x + 1 < 9.

Subtract 1 from all parts: −4 ≤ 2x < 8.

Divide all parts by 2.

Answer: −2 ≤ x < 4

Common mistakes

  • Forgetting to reverse the sign after dividing by a negative.
  • Doing a step to only one or two parts of a three-part inequality.
  • Mixing up and/or: “between” is and; “less than … or more than …” is or.
  • Using a filled circle for < or >. Only ≤ and ≥ get filled circles.

faq.q: When do you flip the inequality sign?
faq.a: Only when you multiply or divide both sides by a negative number. Adding or subtracting never flips it.
Two inequalities joined by and or or. And means both are true (−2 < x ≤ 3); or means at least one is true (x < −2 or x ≥ 3).

faq.q: How do you solve a three-part inequality?
faq.a: Do the same operation to all three parts until x is alone in the middle. If you divide by a negative, reverse both signs.

faq.q: How do you graph an or inequality?
faq.a: Draw two rays going in opposite directions, with an open circle for < or > and a filled circle for ≤ or ≥.

items.q: Which compound inequality is shown on the number line?
items.e: The graph is the part between 1 and 6, so it is an and inequality. A filled circle is included; an open circle is not. So 1 < x ≤ 6.

items.q: Which compound inequality is shown on the number line?
items.e: The graph goes left from −3 and right from −1, so it is an or inequality. Filled circles are included (≤ or ≥); open circles are not. So x < −3 or x > −1.

items.q: Which compound inequality is shown on the number line?
items.e: The graph goes left from −1 and right from 4, so it is an or inequality. Filled circles are included (≤ or ≥); open circles are not. So x ≤ −1 or x > 4.

items.q: A streaming plan costs $12 a month. Liam has at most $100 to spend. Which inequality shows the number of months m?
items.e: “At most” means ≤: 12m ≤ 100.

items.q: A rideshare costs $3.50 plus $1.75 per mile. Emma has $24. What is the greatest whole number of miles she can ride?
Ethan has scores of 78, 85 and 90. What is the lowest score on the fourth test that gives a mean of at least 85?
A truck can carry at most 2,000 lb. The driver weighs 180 lb and each box weighs 65 lb. What is the greatest number of boxes?
Healthy body temperature is between 97 °F and 99 °F, inclusive. Which compound inequality shows the temperature t?
items.e: “Inclusive” means both ends are included: 97 ≤ t ≤ 99.

items.q: A ride is closed to people shorter than 48 in. or taller than 76 in. Which inequality shows the heights h that are NOT allowed?
items.e: Shorter than 48 or taller than 76: h < 48 or h > 76.

items.q: Gym A costs $40 a month. Gym B costs $25 a month plus a $90 joining fee. For how many months m is Gym B cheaper?
A phone plan costs $30 plus $0.10 per text. The bill must stay under $45. What is the greatest number of texts?
items.e: 30 + 0.1t < 45, so t < 150. The greatest whole number is 149.

items.q: A club needs between $500 and $800 for a trip. It has $140 and raises $40 per car wash. Which inequality gives the number of car washes c?
The sum of two consecutive integers is less than 45. What is the greatest possible smaller integer?
items.e: n + (n + 1) < 45, so 2n < 44 and n < 22. The greatest is 21.

items.q: A rectangle has width 6 ft and length x ft. Its perimeter must be at most 50 ft. Which is correct?
Which number is a solution of 2x − 3 < −5 or 2x − 3 > 7?
items.e: The inequality means x < −1 or x > 5. Only 6 works.

items.q: Which number is a solution of −1 < 3x + 2 < 11?
items.e: Subtract 2 and divide by 3: −1 < x < 3. Only 2 works.

items.q: A thermostat keeps a room within 2 °F of 70 °F. Which inequality shows the temperature t?
items.e: Within 2 of 70 means from 68 to 72: 68 ≤ t ≤ 72.

items.q: What is the solution of 2x > 6 and 2x < 4?
items.e: x > 3 and x < 2 cannot both be true: no solution.

items.q: What is the solution of x > 1 or x < 4?
items.e: Every number is greater than 1 or less than 4 (or both): all real numbers.

items.q: Grace earns $15 an hour and wants to earn at least $240 but no more than $360 a week. How many hours h can she work?

items.e: 5 − 2x − 2 ≥ 9, so −2x ≥ 6. Divide by −2 and reverse: x ≤ −3.

items.q: A school dance needs at least 120 tickets sold to break even. 47 have been sold and 8 students each sell t more. What is the smallest t?
items.e: 47 + 8t ≥ 120, so 8t ≥ 73 and t ≥ 9.125. The smallest whole number is 10.

items.q: Which inequality is the same as −4 < −2x ≤ 6?
items.e: Divide every part by −2 and reverse both signs: 2 > x ≥ −3, which is −3 ≤ x < 2.
